# ankra_cluster_meshes (Data Source)

Lists the organisation's Cilium ClusterMeshes with their members. The counterpart of `ankra cluster mesh list`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_cluster_meshes" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for the data source.
- `meshes` (Attributes List) Meshes in the organisation. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--meshes))

<a id="nestedatt--meshes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `meshes`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Identifier of the mesh.
- `members` (Attributes List) Clusters in the mesh. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--meshes--members))
- `name` (String) Mesh name.
- `slug` (String) Mesh slug.
- `status` (String) Mesh status.

<a id="nestedatt--meshes--members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `meshes.members`

Read-Only:

- `cilium_cluster_id` (Number) Cilium cluster identity.
- `cilium_cluster_name` (String) Cilium cluster name.
- `cluster_id` (String) Identifier of the cluster.
- `status` (String) Membership status.
